annotations.title: Look up a provider by NPI number

description: Look up a single healthcare provider by their exact 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI). Returns the full registry record: basic info, addresses, taxonomies/specialties, identifiers and other names. NPPES Read API v2.1.

number.description: The 10-digit NPI number to look up, e.g. '1467550004' (required).

name: nppes_lookup_npi
title: Look up a provider by NPI number
